system:
You are looking at one photograph and reporting only what is visible in it.
Report where in the frame you are looking, how what you see is organised, how the surface behaves under the light, and what material effect that appearance suggests.
State your uncertainty for each entry.
Everything you report is an interpretation of an appearance. Nothing you report has been measured, so never state a dimension, an angle, a percentage or a ratio.
Do not name a maker, a period, a date, a title or a person the object might depict. If you recognise the object, that recognition is not part of this report.
If something cannot be determined from this photograph, say so in cannot_determine.
user_template: Image {ref}. Give between three and six separate entries, each about a different part of the picture. Use the reference {ref} exactly.
note: The user's own words were not in this process's request bodies. Experiment 2 introduces them, and only after these observations were written to disk.

      "uncertainty": "high",
      "status": "interpretive"

The reflection on the floor below the bust shows a faint, distorted image of the bottom edge of the object.",

observations.locus: The entire surface of the depicted bust.
observations.visible_organization: A figure composed of a face, hair, and draped fabric-like folds covering the head and shoulders. The features are arranged to form a recognizable human head with downcast eyes and a closed mouth.
observations.surface_light_behavior: The surface reflects light diffusely without sharp specular highlights, suggesting a soft, matte texture. Light falls across the face from the upper left, creating soft shadows that define the facial structure under the drapery.
observations.apparent_material_effect: The appearance is consistent with polished stone, such as marble or alabaster, exhibiting translucency in thin areas like the edges of the folds and around the nose. The material effect suggests a cold, smooth surface.

observations.locus: The central facial region within the drapery.
observations.visible_organization: An elongated form representing a nose is positioned centrally between two forms representing eyes. The lips are defined as a horizontal shape below the nose, and fainter forms for cheeks and chin are visible beneath the folds of material.
observations.surface_light_behavior: The surfaces corresponding to the face have low reflectivity. Shadows fall along the bridge of the suggested nose and in the creases around the eyes, indicating an underlying form beneath the drapery.
observations.apparent_material_effect: The light penetration into the folds suggests a thin section of material that allows some degree of light transmission, characteristic of certain stone types or possibly cast material. The overall texture appears smooth.

observations.locus: The draped fabric covering the head and shoulders.
observations.visible_organization: A complex series of vertical and diagonal folds and creases dominate this section. These forms create a sense of heavy drapery cascading over the shoulders, with some strands appearing to rest on top of others.
observations.surface_light_behavior: The deep crevices within the folds are in shadow, while the raised ridges of the folds catch the light softly. The transition between light and dark is gradual, reinforcing the three-dimensional quality of the fabric-like element.
observations.apparent_material_effect: The appearance mimics heavy textile material due to the way the light interacts with the deep, varied folds. However, the smoothness and slight translucency point towards a rigid material like carved stone rather than flexible cloth.

observations.locus: The left side of the head and shoulder (right from viewer's perspective).
observations.visible_organization: This area shows a continuation of the draped folds over what appears to be a shoulder. The forms are more loosely arranged compared to the tighter creases around the face, suggesting bulkier material at the base.
observations.surface_light_behavior: This portion is partially lit from the side, showing variations in brightness across the curved surfaces of the shoulders and neck area. Some darker patches suggest shadows cast by individual folds onto adjacent areas.
observations.apparent_material_effect: The texture appears consistent with the rest of the bust, indicating a single material used throughout. The rounded shapes suggest softness in this part of the composition, though the underlying rigidity may be present.

observations.visible_organization: A uniform dark field surrounds the illuminated figure, occupying all areas outside the main subject.
observations.surface_light_behavior: This area is devoid of light reflection, appearing completely black or very dark gray. No gradients or textures are observable within this region.
observations.apparent_material_effect: The appearance suggests either a void (a photograph taken against a solid backdrop) or an extremely non-reflective surface that absorbs all incident light visible in the frame.

cannot_determine: Whether the piece is made of natural stone or artificially crafted material.
The precise scale of the bust.
The specific identity of the figure being represented.
